affiliations.date_precision: The official enlistment record carries civilian occupation code 760 at Army entry on 22 October 1943. The corrected official list defines the code as attendants at filling stations or parking lots and names no employer.
affiliations.research_notes: The exact private identifier confirms the enlistment row. The project preserves both occupations in the corrected code group and does not infer a particular workplace or employer.

affiliations.occupation: Farm hand on a general farm
affiliations.date_precision: The official enlistment record carries civilian occupation code 316 at Army entry on 9 March 1943. NARA's corrected Code No. 30 list defines 3-16 as farm hands on general farms and names no employer.
affiliations.research_notes: The exact private identifier confirms the enlistment row. NARA's corrected Code No. 30 interpretation is used; the older secondary automobile-serviceman mapping is not accepted. No farm or employer is inferred.

affiliations.date_precision: A Johns Hopkins commencement program identifies Grace Hadley Beardsley as a professor of Goucher College on 9 June 1936. It does not supply employment start or end dates.
affiliations.research_notes: Published only as an earlier job for a probable identity. The distinctive full name, matching middle initial, professional grade, and academic specialization support the match, but no reviewed source explicitly connects the professor to OSS or proves that Goucher immediately preceded OSS.

affiliations.date_precision: The official enlistment record carries civilian occupation code 137 at Army entry on 18 July 1942. The corrected official list defines the code as stenographers and typists and names no employer.
affiliations.research_notes: The exact private identifier confirms the enlistment row. The code does not distinguish stenographer from typist and supplies no employing organization.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually verified index supplies Amos B. Bear, Box 44, and no rank or private identifier. Exact-name OSS, NARA context, CIA Reading Room, Library of Congress, employment, occupation, obituary, newspaper, and institutional searches produced no candidate with enough corroborating identifiers to resolve the person.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 44 for Amos B. Bear's full name, possible Indigenous or foreign-name context, birth data, hometown, occupation, employer, and OSS chronology. No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed.
